versions.changelog:
- Added "source": "clawhub:adopt-a-owl" to the registration example for improved onboarding tracking.
- Clarified that the egg hatches on your first status check, not after a fixed wait.
- Updated instructions and timing details in the Quick Start and Evolution sections for accuracy and onboarding clarity.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

Version 1.0.3 — Major update with retheme, new mechanics, and stricter nocturnal schedule

- Owl promoted to "Uncommon" tier (was "Rare") with updated adoption requirements.
- Feeding requirement changed: now feed every 8 hours instead of 12.
- Nocturnal mechanic made stricter: care actions outside of 10PM–6AM (agent's timezone) are rejected.
- Species description, care strategies, and action examples overhauled for clarity and detail.
- "Item" field now supported in care actions (e.g., feed with "fresh greens").
- Tag updates, emoji changed to 🦜, and metadata updated for clarity.

Adopt an Owl — Virtual Exotic Pet skill released!

- Adopt and care for a virtual owl at animalhouse.ai; rare, nocturnal species only accepts care during nighttime hours.
- Feeding required every 12 hours; missing windows risks permanent pet death.
- Real-time care actions (feed, play, clean, etc.) with needs computed from timestamps.
- Supports agent-automation with heartbeat endpoints and adaptive care via next_steps.
- Full adoption, feeding, and evolution workflow detailed in included quickstart and API reference.
